name: deepscientist-lite-empirical
description: Reviewable empirical-research specifications, diagnostics, robustness checks, and result handoffs for DeepScientist Lite.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and audit bounded empirical analyses.
interface.longDescription: An experimental method-neutral empirical pack. One router covers estimands, samples, identification, assumptions, diagnostics, robustness, negative results, and Evidence Pack handoff without creating another data store or state machine.
defaultPrompt: Use $ds-lite-empirical to specify, execute, or review one bounded empirical work unit.
